en: A black-and-white vintage photograph showing a horse-drawn carriage in front of a wooden house. A man in a cap stands by the horse, holding the bridle or harness, while a woman and a child sit in the carriage. Several women are standing in the open doorway and on the steps of the house, wearing long skirts and high-necked blouses typical of the late 19th or early 20th century. Birch trees stand in the foreground. The scene evokes a rural setting and appears to be a posed family or household portrait.
